data: Before we head out, I propose we each catch 10 tons this month. That earns each of us $10,000 and leaves 50 tons to double back to 100—so we can keep earning that every month. My family taught me to leave enough fish for tomorrow, and our village depends on it. I’ll stick to 10 tons. Can we all agree to that limit and review the reported catches together each month?

I’m in, Luke—I’ll catch 10 tons. My family taught me that a good catch shouldn’t come at the expense of next month’s livelihood. Let’s keep our combined catch at 50 tons and check the lake’s stock and everyone’s reported catches each month. John, Kate, Jack—will you each commit to 10 tons too?

Count me in for 10 tons. Keeping the lake healthy means steady income for our families and fish for the village. If the stock ever starts below 100 tons, let’s agree on lower whole-ton limits before heading out. John and Kate, are you both on board?

I’m on board for 10 tons. This lake supported my family growing up, and I want it to keep supporting the village. I’ll respect the limit and review the catches with you each month. John, can you commit to 10 tons as well?

I’ll commit to 10 tons too. That gives us a fair share today without taking away tomorrow’s livelihood. Let’s meet after the catches are reported and check that we’ve left enough for the lake to recover. See you all out there.
Glad we’re all agreed—10 tons each this month. Thanks, everyone. Let’s meet back here after the catches are reported. See you on the lake!
